§6Backpack Upgrades§f

§aMake your backpack actually do something useful§f

Backpacks aren't just bigger inventories. Each one has upgrade points you can spend on functional modules. §9Shift + Right-click§f your backpack or open its GUI to see the upgrade slots.

§6Available Upgrades§f:
§b• Blank Upgrade§f: The base template for crafting all other upgrades. §e1 point§f.
§b• Latch Upgrade§f: Locks your backpack so contents stay put. §e1 point§f.
§b• Damage Bar Upgrade§f: Shows a fill bar on the backpack icon so you know how full it is without opening it. §e1 point§f.
§b• Extra Upgrade§f: Grants §e+1 upgrade point§f to the backpack. Yes, it pays for itself and then some. §e-1 point§f (net gain).

§cWARNING:§f The Everlasting Upgrade has been §cdisabled§f in this pack. Don't plan around it.

§ePS:§f Check JEI for all upgrade recipes. The Blank Upgrade is just string, paper, and a stick, so stock up.
